description: Mutants of the rollback Module (docs/architecture/target/v2/authority-rollback-declaration.zh-Hant.md section 9.4; tests/common/mutation/README.md). Run with tests/common/mutation/run_mutations.py --catalog.

mutants.what: the first registration of a type counts, whatever its source (rollback 5.4: the author's over one made on behalf, whatever the order). Only it catches the author's preference
mutants.find: const Source counts = anyAuthor ? Source::Author : Source::OnBehalf;
mutants.cases: rollback registrations: the author's registration counts*

mutants.what: two registrations of one source with different options are not reported (RB-E1). Only it catches the conflict
mutants.find:
errors.push_back(describe(*chosen, std::string("two of ") + SourceText(counts) +
                                                       " registrations with different options"));
mutants.cases: rollback registrations: two of the author's*

mutants.what: RB-E1 does not name the type. Only it catches the name in the report
mutants.cases: rollback registrations: two of the author's*

mutants.what: a type that may roll back but is not registered in the World is not reported (RB-E2). Only it catches the data check
mutants.cases: rollback registrations: what the read-only registry*

mutants.what: an input not registered in the World is not reported (RB-E3). Only it catches the input check
mutants.cases: rollback registrations: what the read-only registry*

mutants.what: a step schedule the World does not have is not reported (RB-E4). Only it catches the step schedule check
mutants.find: context.Report("RB-E4", "rollback.StepSchedule '" + record.name + "': no schedule of that name in this World");
mutants.cases: rollback registrations: what the read-only registry*

mutants.what: a nested schedule whose step schedule is not registered is not reported (RB-E5). Only it catches that check
mutants.cases: rollback registrations: what the read-only registry*

mutants.what: the chosen strategy's startup check is not run (rollback 5.3). Only it catches the call
SkipDuringResimulation gives no run condition: the System runs while resimulating. Only it catches the condition
mutants.cases: rollback registrations: a System registered as skipped*

mutants.what: SkipDuringResimulation is not recorded in the registrations (the authority Module reads it). Only it catches the record
the run condition is true while resimulating and false otherwise. Only it catches the condition's sense
mutants.cases: rollback registrations: a System registered as skipped*

mutants.what: the resolved registrations are not put into the World (authority-rollback 5.1: read at run time from the World's Resource). Only it catches the prepare function
a registration after Build is appended (declaration 6: the owner refuses it). Only it catches the owner's freeze check
mutants.find: GYO_ASSERT(!buffer_->Frozen() && "a rollback registration after Build: the registrations are frozen");
mutants.cases: rollback registrations: a registration after Build*
mutants.expect: through an entry kept from Build[\s\S]*expected GYO_ASSERT to fail|expected GYO_ASSERT to fail[\s\S]*through an entry kept from Build
